config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Absolute path of the default project to checkpoint, used when the client has no current project (e.g. Claude Desktop). A projectRoot argument on a tool call takes precedence.

config.label: Set automatically by Claude Code; do not set it yourself
config.description: Set automatically by Claude Code; do not set it yourself. Selects the per-session checkpoint file (.claude-checkpoints/<session-id>.json). Without it the server mints a session id per conversation, or uses the shared .claude-checkpoint file with CHECKPOINT_SESSION_IDS=legacy.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Unset or mint: clients without a session id get their own checkpoint per conversation (the server mints an id on the first save and the agent passes it back). Set to legacy to have them share one .claude-checkpoint file, as before 1.0. No effect on Claude Code.
